analysis.summary: Management reported a strong operational and financial performance for Q4 and full year FY26, driven by robust volume growth in branded footwear and lifestyle apparel, particularly across Tier 2 and Tier 3 towns. Full year FY26 revenue reached INR2,415 crores, representing a growth of 19.6% over FY25, while EBITDA margins expanded to 19% on the back of operating leverage and cost efficiencies. The company also announced a final dividend recommendation of INR2 per equity share and highlighted ongoing investments in brands, technology, and omnichannel expansion. RedTape Limited reported audited financial results for the fourth quarter and financial year ended March 31, 2026, showing full-year revenue of ₹2,415 Cr, representing a 19.6% year-on-year growth. Management highlighted that EBITDA margins improved by 151 bps to 19.0% for FY26, driven by operating leverage, store maturity, and disciplined cost management.

guidance.claim: RedTape Limited targets continued strong revenue growth in FY27 through accelerated retail expansion, category diversification, and channel growth.
guidance.quote: RedTape Limited targets continued strong revenue growth in FY27, supported by accelerated retail expansion, with a particular focus on South and West India, along with category diversification, e-commerce and quick commerce channel growth, women’s and kids’ segment development, and premiumisation.

guidance.claim: The company intends to open 200-250 new stores annually with store sizes ranging from 500 sq. ft. to 1,500 sq. ft.
guidance.quote: The Company intends to open 200-250 new stores annually with store size of 500sq. ft. – 1500 sq. ft., deepen its presence in Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities, scale the Ozark performance wear brand, and extend its lifestyle portfolio into new product categories including backpacks, luggage, and fragrances and cosmetics.

demand_outlook.claim: The underlying demand for branded footwear and lifestyle apparel in India remains very much intact.
demand_outlook.quote: While the first half had its moments of softness, the second half and particularly Q3, carrying into Q4, showed us clearly that the underlying demand for branded footwear and lifestyle apparel in India is very much intact.

demand_outlook.claim: Consumers in Tier 2 and Tier 3 towns are making a clear and steady shift toward organized branded products.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian consumer, especially in Tier 2 and Tier 3 towns where the majority of our stores sit, is making a clear and steady shift towards organized branded product.

demand_outlook.claim: The GST reduction on footwear below INR2,500 served as a meaningful volume catalyst.
demand_outlook.quote: The GST reduction on footwear below INR2,500 was a meaningful volume catalyst for us, specifically because nearly all of our products sit in that bracket.

demand_outlook.claim: Consumer sentiment in core segments such as casual, athleisure, and activewear remains resilient.
demand_outlook.quote: Consumer sentiment in our core segments, particularly casual, athleisure and activewear, has remained resilient.

demand_outlook.claim: Consumer confidence in branded footwear has never been stronger.
demand_outlook.quote: Consumer confidence in branded footwear has never been stronger, and RedTape has been well-placed to earn that trust across every touchpoint, whether it is a flagship store in a metro or a first-time buyer discovering us on Flipkart in a Tier-3 town.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian consumer is trading up and looking for trusted brands across categories under one roof.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian consumer is trading up. Families want a brand they can trust across footwear, apparel and accessories, all under one roof.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to add almost 200 to 250 stores with sizes ranging between 500 and 1,500 square feet.
capex_expansion.quote: We are planning to add almost 200 to 250 stores. Having said that, the square feet of the store would be around 500 to 1,500 square feet.

capex_expansion.claim: One new marketplace warehouse was operationalised in FY26 alongside 3,00,000 sq. ft. added in the existing Unnao warehouse.
capex_expansion.quote: • Marketplace Warehouse: One new warehouse operationalised in FY26; 3,00,000 sq.ft. added in existing warehouse of Unnao, Kanpur.

capex_expansion.claim: The company reported a net addition of approximately 1,61,320 sq. ft. of retail space for the first nine months of FY26.
RedTape launched two new brands named Mode and Bond Street.
capex_expansion.quote: Launch of two new brands Mode and Bond Street

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins expanded from 17.5% in FY25 to 19% in FY26 due to operating leverage and cost efficiency measures.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA margins expanded from 17.5% in FY25 to 19% in FY26, and this was on the back of operating leverage and cost efficiency measures.

margins_costs.claim: Pre-Ind AS EBITDA margin stands at around 16.4%.
The company is not planning to increase MRPs or change pricing near term despite market cost pressures.
margins_costs.quote: As of today, we are not increasing any MRPs or nothing. We are doing nothing of that sort.

margins_costs.claim: Margin improvement for the year was driven by store maturity, better brand mix, and disciplined cost management.
margins_costs.quote: Margin improvement this year has been a direct outcome of store maturity, better brand mix, and disciplined cost management, and not a one-quarter phenomenon.

margins_costs.claim: For the full year, EBITDA margin expansion can be attributed to operating leverage.
margins_costs.quote: • For full year, the EBITDA margins can be attributed to operating leverage

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin was impacted due to an accounting change for the e-commerce channel.
margins_costs.quote: • Gross Margin impacted owing to accounting change for the e-commerce channel

margins_costs.claim: Standalone EBITDA margin for Q3 FY26 stood at 22.57%.
Consolidated EBITDA for Q3 FY26 was reported at 17,796 lakh.
Standalone PAT grew by 42.72% for Q3 FY26.
Consolidated PAT for Q3 FY26 reached 10,453 lakh, reflecting a 43.05% growth.
margins_costs.quote: Consolidated Profit After Tax (PAT) rose to 10,453 lakh, a 43.05% growth.

orders_capacity.claim: Same-store sales growth (SSSG) was 17.8% in Q4.
orders_capacity.quote: Our SSSG, which is the same-store sales growth was 17.8% in Q4.

orders_capacity.claim: The company ended the year with 223 exclusive showrooms across 161 cities.
orders_capacity.quote: On our network, we ended the year with 223 exclusive showrooms across 161 cities.

orders_capacity.claim: The store count has currently crossed 550 stores.
orders_capacity.quote: As we speak, we have crossed 550 stores as we speak.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates a total retail store footprint of 669 stores across 300 cities.
orders_capacity.quote: • Our footprint now spans across the UK, UAE, Bangladesh, Bhutan, Sri Lanka, Maldives, Singapore, Australia, Seychelles, Turkiye, among others

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates a total of 662 stores as of December 31, 2025.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board has recommended a final dividend of INR2 per equity share on a face value of INR2.
capital_allocation.quote: We are pleased to announce that the Board has recommended a final INR2 per equity share on the face value of INR2.

risks_headwinds.claim: The beginning of FY26 involved uncertainties including input costs, a mixed first half, and consumer hesitation around the GST transition.
risks_headwinds.quote: When the year started, the environment was not without its uncertainties of input costs, a mixed first half, some consumer hesitation around the GST transition, to name a few.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to reduce inventory days to a target range of 120 days to 150 days.
The company plans to scale the Ozark retail footprint due to strong response in the performance outdoor category.
management_commitments.quote: The consumer appetite for a credible Indian brand in the performance outdoor category is larger than we initially estimated, and we are scaling the Ozark retail footprint accordingly.

management_commitments.claim: The company is actively investing in the apparel segment for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: This is the segment we are most actively investing for FY27 also.

management_commitments.claim: The company will push investments further into women's apparel in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We are investing meaningfully behind women's apparel as well and we’ll push this further in FY27.

management_commitments.claim: RedTape Limited targets continued strong revenue growth in FY27 supported by accelerated retail expansion and category diversification.
management_commitments.quote: RedTape Limited targets continued strong revenue growth in FY27, supported by accelerated retail expansion, with a particular focus on South and West India, along with category diversification, e-commerce and quick commerce channel growth, women’s and kids’ segment development, and premiumisation.

management_commitments.claim: The Company intends to open 200-250 new stores annually with store size of 500 sq. ft. to 1,500 sq. ft.
management_commitments.quote: The Company intends to open 200-250 new stores annually with store size of 500sq. ft. – 1500 sq. ft., deepen its presence in Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities, scale the Ozark performance wear brand, and extend its lifestyle portfolio into new product categories including backpacks, luggage, and fragrances and cosmetics.

management_commitments.claim: RedTape aims to scale Ozark's retail footprint, strengthen product innovation, and increase its contribution to overall RedTape sales.
management_commitments.quote: The Company’s focus for FY2025-26 is to scale Ozark’s retail footprint, strengthen product innovation, and increase its contribution to overall RedTape sales.

management_commitments.claim: The company's vision is to deepen its presence across key cities to make RedTape a stronger household name.
management_commitments.quote: The Company’s vision for FY2025-26 is to deepen its presence across key cities, making RedTape a stronger household name in both premium lifestyle and performance segments.

management_commitments.claim: RedTape aims to amplify its homegrown brands Mode and Bond Street to establish them as renowned names in India's fashion landscape.
management_commitments.quote: Alongside Ozark, RedTape aims to amplify its other homegrown brands — Mode and Bond Street — establishing them as renowned names in India’s fashion and lifestyle landscape, reinforcing the brand’s leadership in the segment.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
